candidate.derivedAnswer: Some men are dishonest, choice C
candidate.answerReason: A universal statement is false exactly when at least one member fails its stated property.

methods.label: Find what makes the universal statement false
methods.explanation: The statement “all men are honest” fails if at least one man is not honest. Its negation is therefore “some men are dishonest,” where “some” means at least one. It does not require every man to be dishonest. The answer is choice C.
methods.levelReason: This uses only the elementary meanings of universal and existential statements.

candidate.annotationRationale: The question directly assesses negating a statement with one universal quantifier. Understanding “all” and “at least one” is the supporting quantifier concept.
